The Problem

Google penalises slow sites. Visitors just leave.

Most modern websites are weighed down by unnecessary code, page builders, and inefficient design choices. Every extra second of load time is a visitor closing the tab — and a lower ranking that makes the next one harder to find.

A slow website isn't just annoying — it's costing you customers

Our Approach
We build websites properly — from the ground up

At Dhoop, every website is hand-built using clean, efficient code. We focus on structure, speed, and technical SEO from the very beginning — ensuring every build performs against Google Web Vitals standards.

No templates. No page builders. No unnecessary bloat.

Performance Authority

Built with Google Web Vitals in mind

Every website we build is measured against real performance standards — not guesswork. That means faster load times, stronger SEO signals, and better user experience across all devices.

Performance is not optional — it's the foundation
